Building and bases

Arrange solo storage and doors around daily use

Keep everyday tools, fuel and common materials convenient, and split valuables among deeper storage areas. Extend the door path as resources allow, checking that each door and box remains usable.

The source’s large storage layout is an idea, not an unraidable design. Verify building limits, upkeep and defense on your server; a fixed raid cost cannot be promised.
